purpose: Showcase recording only (user instruction 2026-11-17). Never used by the isolated or regular online launchers.
patch_effect: While IOS 249 runs, IOS ES skips the TMD/ticket signature check like the console's d2x cIOS 249 (every other IOS stays strict), so the KWCE installer installs its WADs on camera exactly as on the console
IOS 249 (the console's d2x cIOS, base 56) is emulated with IOS56 memory values and SDv2, so the installer's IOS_ReloadIOS(249) works as on the console
every presented field is flushed to the frame dump, so CPU-drawn console screens (the installer) are recorded
frame dump timestamps are absolute emulated time, so split files line up with the DSP/DTK audio dumps
audio dumps stay on emulated time: when the DSP/DTK delivers no samples (boot, title changes) silence is written, so audio and the absolute-time frame dumps share one timeline
XF clip disable (0x1005 bit 0) is honoured by the hardware-backend vertex shaders (no depth clipping), like the console; stock Dolphin ignores it (only reports a game quirk)
isolation: same bubblewrap online sandbox as workspace/online profiles; only the bound Dolphin prefix differs
note: Earlier rehearsal-only binaries (390a08cd, 3385c973, 2b2f3649, 5c10c8c3, a01dbc6c, a4915d62) were replaced before any final recording. take2 was recorded with 212e6468 (before the clip-disable change).
